Job Title: ServiceNow Integration EngineerJob Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: SecretEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US* * *

The Opportunity:
CACI is seeking a highly motivated and experienced ServiceNow Integration Engineer supporting the Department of the Air Force (DAF) Enterprise IT as a Service (EITaaS) program. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing integrations between ServiceNow and a variety of enterprise systems, with an initial focus on systems critical to our operational workflows. You will work closely with business stakeholders, ServiceNow developers, and other IT teams to ensure seamless data flow and process automation across the organization. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of ServiceNow architecture, integration methodologies, and web service technologies, and will be comfortable working with both established and emerging integration patterns

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and implement integrations between ServiceNow and various enterprise systems, which may include government / DoD systems, vendor and licensing systems and other enterprise tools.
  • Utilize ServiceNow integration technologies such as:

    - REST APIs

    - SOAP APIs

    - MID Servers
    - Integration Hub (Spokes, Flows)
    - JDBC/ODBC Connections
    - Email Integration

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather integration requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, including integration designs, data mappings, and test plans.
  • Perform thorough testing of integrations to ensure data accuracy and functionality.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues in a timely manner.
  • Monitor integration performance and identify opportunities for optimization.
  • Stay up-to-date on the latest features of ServiceNow and integration of best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to the development of coding standards.
  • Work closely with ServiceNow developers to implement custom solutions and enhancements.
  • Contribute to the overall architecture and design of the ServiceNow platform.
  • Automate manual processes using ServiceNow workflows and integrations.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret clearance
  • 12+ Years of relevant experience (Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field may be substituted for 5 years of relevant experience).
  • 3+ years of experience in ServiceNow development and integration.
  • Strong understanding of ServiceNow platform architecture and functionalities.
  • Experience with REST and SOAP APIs.
  • Experience with scripting languages such as JavaScript, Jelly, and AngularJS.
  • Experience with data mapping and transformation.
  • Experience with ServiceNow MID Server configuration and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with Integration Hub and ServiceNow Flow Designer.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification.
  • Experience in integrating with tools and sources for hardware and / or software asset management.
  • Candidate should have a CompTIA Security+ certification or be able to obtain it within 60 days of hire.

Desired:

  • Active Secret clearance.
  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) certification.
  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certification in one or more modules (e.g., ITSM, HRSD, CSM).
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies.
  • Experience with DevOps practices and tools
  • Experience with cloud-based integration platforms
  • Experience with database technologies such as SQL Server, Oracle, or MySQL.
-

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$98,500-$206,800

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

raw.description:
Why Join Giga

  • The Pace: We're building at a speed most companies talk about but never actually operate at. If you've been bored somewhere else, you won't be here.
  • The Impact: Every person at Giga touches the work that matters. No layers, no waiting for approval chains. You'll see your fingerprints on what we ship.
  • The Team: A team of operators defining the future of AI infrastructure. We recruit A-players from the most innovative companies in the world, and they choose Giga because the work here means more.
  • The Moment: AI doesn't run without power, and that's us. Giga is the picks and shovels behind the AI revolution. This industry is about to explode, and you'll be in the room where it's already happening.

What You'll Do

As Senior Product Marketing Manager for AI Data Centers & Development, you will own how Giga tells its story to the market, across our full-stack AI data center offering, from site selection and development through deployment. You are the narrative architect for Giga's most strategic GTM motion.

This role sits at the intersection of product and go-to-market. You will work closely with a technical PM counterpart who owns the infrastructure and equipment narrative, while you focus on the broader data center development story: the sites, the campuses, the full builds. Together, you are the two-person PMM team behind Giga's go-to-markets.

You will shape how hyperscalers, neoclouds, and AI operators understand what Giga builds, why it matters, and why no one else can do it the way we do.

Responsibilities

Core Narrative & Positioning

  • Own the product narrative for Giga's AI data center and full-stack development offering, from positioning and messaging to story architecture across segments
  • Develop and maintain core messaging for hyperscalers, neoclouds, and BTC/HPC operators, tailored to how each segment evaluates and selects development partners
  • Partner with your technical PMM counterpart to ensure infrastructure messaging ladders up into the broader development story

Content & Storytelling

  • Lead the development of case studies, solution narratives, and proof points that demonstrate Giga's full-stack delivery capability
  • Build and refine core product marketing materials: one-pagers, solution briefs, sales enablement decks, and RFP-ready narratives
  • Craft content that earns credibility with deeply technical buyers without losing the strategic story

Launches & Events

  • Drive product launch campaigns for new site and development offerings — from internal alignment through external rollout
  • Own Giga's presence at key industry events: develop showcase narratives, booth experiences, and presentation content that make Giga impossible to ignore
  • Partner with demand gen and content teams to amplify launches across web, social, and outbound channels

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Work directly with business development and sales to understand how buyers think, what objections look like in the field, and where the narrative is winning or falling short
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to stay ahead of what Giga is building and translate it into market-facing stories before the competition can catch up

Requirements

  • Proven product marketing experience with a track record of building compelling product narratives from scratch
  • Elite storytelling ability: you can take a complex, multi-component offering and distill it into a clear, differentiated, and emotionally resonant story
  • Demonstrated experience owning high-impact deliverables: case studies, positioning documents, launch campaigns, or event showcases
  • Comfortable working closely with technical counterparts and translating what engineers and PMs build into what buyers need to hear
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment.

Bonus Points

  • Background in or exposure to data centers, AI infrastructure, energy infrastructure, or adjacent industries
  • Experience marketing complex, multi-stakeholder infrastructure or enterprise solutions
  • Prior work with hyperscaler or neocloud buyers, or experience in GTM roles targeting technical operators

Who We Hire

We don't use "A-player" loosely. Here's what it actually means at Giga:

Antifragile. You don't just survive chaos, you get better because of it. When things break, change, or move sideways, you don't freeze. You adapt faster than the problem evolves.

High Agency. You don't wait to be told what to do. You see the gap, you fill it. If something is blocking progress, you find a way around it, over it, or through it without asking for permission.

Executors. Ideas are cheap. We hire people who ship. You're the person who turns a whiteboard sketch into something real while everyone else is still scheduling the next meeting about it.

Bias to Action. Perfect is the enemy of done. You'd rather make a decision with 80% of the information and course correct than sit around waiting for 100% that never comes.

Speed. We move fast because the opportunity demands it. You're not reckless, but you understand that in this industry, the team that moves fastest wins. And you like winning.

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

Giga Energy is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Giga Energy complies with all applicable labor laws, including the California Fair Employment and Housing Act (FEHA) and other relevant state and federal regulations. We provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and encourage applicants who require accommodations during the hiring process to contact us.

  • Proficiency in modern design and prototyping tools
  • Experience working in cross-functional product teams
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Understanding of accessibility and usability best practices
  • Experience contributing to or working within design systems

Role Overview

The Market Development Manager is role responsible for the development and execution of global, customer-focused marketing strategies that support the Microbiology Division’s strategic priorities and revenue objectives. This role owns the planning, build, and execution of annual customer campaigns for key target audiences, translating portfolio and go-to-market strategies into high-impact global marketing programs.

Working in a highly matrixed environment, you will partner closely with product management, e-business, sales, and regional marketing teams to define customer-centric value propositions, drive demand generation, and ensure strong regional adoption of global marketing strategies.

Key Responsibilities

Global Campaign Strategy & Execution

  • Lead the development and execution of integrated, customer-focused global marketing strategies and campaigns that drive pipeline creation, customer acquisition, and portfolio growth
  • Define target audiences and personas; develop differentiated value propositions and content strategies aligned to customer needs and buying journeys
  • Own campaign architecture across content, channels, and touchpoints, ensuring a cohesive and optimized customer experience
  • Partner with regional marketing teams to ensure effective localization, adoption, and execution of global campaigns, extending into sales activation initiatives

Customer Journey, Demand Generation & Digital Excellence

  • Partner closely with e-business to optimize channel mix, digital performance, and campaign effectiveness
  • Improve lead quality and conversion through optimized marketing automation programs (MAPs), WebUX enhancements, and application/workflow-based content
  • Leverage digital analytics, marketing automation, and CRM insights to assess campaign performance, improve lead nurturing, and increase funnel conversion
  • Continuously apply learnings from campaign performance data to refine content, targeting, and activation strategies

Go-to-Market Strategy & Market Expansion

  • Support go-to-market strategies for existing portfolios and new product launches, ensuring strong alignment between product positioning, customer needs, and marketing execution
  • Analyze market trends, customer insights, and competitive dynamics to identify new growth opportunities (e.g., new regions, adjacent markets, or applications)
  • Contribute to defining market opportunity (addressable and non-addressable) and shaping marketing strategies that support expansion priorities
  • Gather and synthesize customer and field feedback to inform product development and improve market fit, communicating insights clearly to internal stakeholders

Stakeholder Partnership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Build strong, trusted partnerships with cross-functional and regional stakeholders, including product management, e-business, sales, and regional marketing teams, to align on shared objectives and deliver integrated marketing outcomes
  • Facilitate collaboration across global and regional teams to translate strategic priorities into clear, actionable marketing plans that are consistently executed in market
  • Drive adoption of global marketing strategies by working collaboratively with regional teams to balance global consistency with local market needs

Performance Metrics, Planning & Reporting

  • Develop and manage the global marketing plan and calendar, including accurate budget planning and monthly OPEX management
  • Define and track KPIs that measure campaign success, including pipeline contribution, lead quality, conversion rates, and regional adoption of global strategies
  • Partner with e-business to analyze and report on campaign, vertical, and product-level performance, including pull-through to revenue
  • Provide regular performance updates and insights to stakeholders, using data to inform current and future marketing plans

Minimum Requirements / Qualifications

  • Proven experience in marketing roles within applied microbiology and/or life sciences, with specific experience in microbiology diagnostics marketing
  • Demonstrated success leading marketing campaigns in a matrixed organization, with clear impact on demand generation and growth
  • Strong experience partnering with e-business teams, including exposure to marketing automation platforms, digital analytics, and CRM integration
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex strategies to senior leadership and diverse global audiences
  • Strong project management skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple complex initiatives simultaneously
  • Creative mindset with strong intuition for customer-centric design and messaging, paired with a data-driven approach to continuous improvement
  • Experience delivering presentations and training to sales teams, regional marketing teams, and customers
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships with customers and key opinion leaders
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (~25%)

raw.description:
Bullhorn ist der weltweit führende Softwareanbieter für die Personal- und Rekrutierungsbranche.Mehr als 10.000 Unternehmen verlassen sich auf die Cloud-basierte Plattform von Bullhorn, um ihre Rekrutierungsprozesse von Start bis Ende zu unterstützen. Durch unsere innovativen Produkte und Services schaffen wir es unsere Kunden zu begeistern und unser Kundenportfolio auszubauen, was zu weiteren Unternehmenswachstum führt und somit unseren Mitarbeitern ständig neue Möglichkeiten bietet, ihre Karriere voranzutreiben. 25 % unserer weltweiten Belegschaft werden jedes Jahr befördert oder wechseln in eine neue Position, erweitern ihre Fähigkeiten und arbeiten mit neuen Leuten zusammen. Bullhorn hat die Größe, um diese aufregenden Möglichkeiten zu bieten, ist aber klein genug, um die Energie eines Startups weiterhin aufrechtzuerhalten,und wir werden aufgrund unserer starken Unternehmenskultur und Karrieremöglichkeiten regelmäßig als attraktiver Arbeitgeber eingestuft.

Unser Engagement für unsere Mitarbeiter: Jeder Bullhorn Mitarbeiter hat ein Zugehörigkeitsgefühl, eine gehörte Stimme und einen klaren Karriereweg zum Erfolg. Bullhorn bietet bei angemessener Leistung unlimitierte Urlaubstage pro Jahr, großartige berufliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, vierteljährlich bezahlte Volunteer Tage durch seine philanthropische Gruppe Bullhorn Cares und die Einladung einer Bullhorn Allianz Gruppe beizutreten, die Vielfalt und aktive Einbeziehung aller Mitarbeiter feiert und pflegt.

Unsere Mitarbeiter onsite im Büro genießen eine lockere, gemeinschaftliche Umgebung mit wöchentlichem Catering Leistungen sowie vierteljährlichen gesellschaftlichen Veranstaltungen.Für Remote Tätigkeit oder als Remote schaffender Mitarbeiter wo Sie bequem von zu Hause aus arbeiten, erhalten Sie das nötige technische Equipment mit allen Tools die Sie für Ihre Arbeit benötigen. Wir verwenden Zoom, Slack und andere Tools, um in Verbindung zu bleiben, während wir Remote sind.

Rollenbeschreibung

Du berichtest an unseren Regional Director (EMEA) of Field Sales und bist dafür verantwortlich, innerhalb eines definierten Gebiets (DACH) neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu erschließen. Dabei positionierst du Bullhorn und die damit verbundenen Dienstleistungen so, dass der Kunde einen echten Wettbewerbsvorteil erkennen kann.

Der Schwerpunkt deiner Tätigkeit liegt auf der Identifizierung und Umsetzung von Vertriebszielen, einschließlich der detaillierten Verfolgung von Leads zum Aufbau einer qualifizierten Pipeline, Präsentationen für potenzielle Kunden, Analysegesprächen, Produktdemonstrationen und Vertragsverhandlungen.

Unsere Mission ist es, ein erstklassiges Kundenerlebnis zu bieten. Dabei stehst du an vorderster Front, um dies vom ersten Kontakt an sicherzustellen.
Du hilfst potenziellen Kunden dabei, ihren Kaufprozess zu steuern, Lösungen zur Bewältigung ihrer wichtigsten geschäftlichen Herausforderungen zu evaluieren und Technologien zu implementieren, die sich positiv auf ihr Unternehmen auswirken. Für diese Position sind fortgeschrittene Beratungsfähigkeiten, ein hohes Interesse an der Personalvermittlungsbranche sowie insbesondere an SaaS und KI erforderlich.

Ein typischer Tag umfasst...

  • Aufbau einer eigenen Lead-Pipeline durch die direkte Ansprache potenzieller Kunden sowie die Qualifizierung und Durchführung von Erstgesprächen und Produktvorführungen

  • Identifizierung neuer potentieller Kunden durch Recherche, Networking, Social Selling und Empfehlungen

  • Erarbeitung von Angeboten in Zusammenarbeit mit Sales Engineering und Professional Services oder Implementierungspartnern.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vertriebsmanagement, um Verkaufschancen zu priorisieren und Vertriebsstrategien umzusetzen, die über die erwarteten Quoten hinausgehen

  • Regelmäßige und zeitnahe Einreichung von Vertriebskennzahlen wie wöchentliche Forecasts, Pipeline-Management und Business-Pläne

  • Trend- und Marktbeobachtung, um immer auf dem neuesten Stand zu sein und dein Vertriebsgebiet bestens beraten zu können

  • Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Webinaren und Präsentationen sowohl online als auch bei regionalen Veranstaltungen.

  • Aufbau eines (Partner-)Netzwerks auf dem Markt

Diese Position ist genau das Richtige für dich, wenn du…

  • 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im SaaS-Vertrieb oder in der Personalvermittlungsbranche hast

  • Nachweisliche Erfolge im B2B-Vertrieb vorweisen kannst

  • Erfahrung im beratenden Vertrieb von komplexe Lösungen hast und es dir leicht fällt mehrere Stakeholder und Entscheidungsträger zu steuern

  • Gerne Kunden vor Ort besuchst und langfristige Beziehungen online und persönlich aufbaust

  • Ein Vertriebsprofi bist und innerhalb der vorgegebenen Richtlinien sehr selbstständig arbeitest

  • Du bereit bist, unseren Erfolg in der DACH-Region weiter auszubauen, um unsere Präsenz zu skalieren

  • Du fließend Deutsch sprichst und über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse auf Geschäftsebene verfügst (hauptsächlich intern)

  • Du einen Job in einem internationalen Umfeld suchst und voll und ganz in den Bereich KI eintauchen möchtest

Abschliessend:

Bullhorn fühlt sich seinen Grundwerten verpflichtet und wir suchen Menschen, die diese Eigenschaften aufweisen und Leben:

  • Service: Herausforderungen werden angepackt und gelöst
  • Energie: Ihre positive Energie steckt andere Teamkollegen an und treibt Sie zu Hochleistungen
  • Eigenverantwortung: Wir übernehmen Verantwortung, ergreifen die Initiative, stehen zu unseren Entscheidungen und tragen die Konsequenzen
  • Geschwindigkeit & Agilität: Hindernisse werden überwunden und mit Dringlichkeit behandelt
  • Mensch sein - Jedem Kollegen schenken wir Zeit, Achtung und Aufmerksamkeit, lachen und haben Spaß.

Bullhorn setzt sich voll und ganz für Chancengleichheit ein. Wir begegnen jedem auf Augenhöhe und mit Respekt. Dies bedeutet, dass alle Bewerber und Mitarbeiter unabhängig von Alter, Behinderung, Familienstand, Ethnie, Religion, Weltanschauung, Geschlecht oder sexueller Orientierung gleich behandelt werden.

About EarnIn

As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.

We’re fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We’re growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.

Position Summary:

We are seeking an experienced Compliance Analyst who will play a critical role in ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and mitigating both current and emerging risks by creatively leveraging data and technology to improve the effectiveness of business and compliance processes.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $85,000-99,300 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location.

This is a remote position.

What You'll Do:

  • Review proposed changes or new products, services or features to identify potential compliance risks or concerns and impact of changes to existing compliance policies and procedures.
  • Provide recommendations for improving the compliance process and enhancing the company’s ability to adapt to regulatory changes.
  • Monitor the implementation of corrective actions and escalate when appropriate.
  • Analyze regulations and their applicability to our products and services, and assist with the development of creative and compliant processes and controls
  • Administer compliance tools, including configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting.

  • Support the development, maintenance, and delivery of employee engagement platforms, dashboards, and reports.

  • Support continuous improvement of employee listening strategies across the full employee lifecycle.

PARTNER RELATIONS DIVISION

PURPOSE SUMMARY

As a member of the Church Engagement & Experiences Department, this external-facing role is primarily responsible for managing relationships with Supporting Church partners within a defined geographic region. The expected outcomes of this role are the formation of deeply collaborative partnerships benefiting each partners’ missional goals and contributing to the achievement of strategic & acquisition goals of our organization. This position reports to the Church Engagement Manager, functions within a team of peer relationship development professionals, and is a key contributor to the organizational mission of seeing children released from poverty in Jesus’ name.

MINISTRY FOCUS

Compassion Canada is a Christian organization, committed to being child-focused, Christ-centered, and church driven. Every Staff member at Compassion Canada will:

  • Agree with Compassion Canada’s core documents, including a Statement of Faith.
  • Conduct themselves in a Christ-like manner at work and outside the workplace.
  • Participate in regular Staff Gatherings which include spiritual practices like worship, Scripture reading, and prayer.
  • Pray with staff or supporters when requested or deemed appropriate.

WHAT YOU DO MATTERS

TASKS & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Maintain relationship with a group of regionally situated Churches for the purpose of fostering collaboration and attending to the resource needs of Compassion’s programmatic activities – Sponsorship, Survival, and Complementary Interventions.
  • Proactively research, prospect, contact, and engage in conversations toward relationship with new Church partners.
  • Implement engaging partnership strategies with agreed-upon and measurable relational landmarks, goals, and vision.
  • Regularly update Customer Relationship Management database with all relational activities (recording both activities completed & expected upcoming next steps).
  • In consultation with their manager, regularly review current activity and acquisition reports related to your portfolio and attend to notable trends.
  • Participate in the refinement, execution, and improvement of relational engagement strategies based on ‘real world’ experience and proven best practices.
  • Attend to maintaining current and accurate knowledge of programmatic activity and international development trends and comprehensively advise on these matters while representing Compassion to our partners & supporters.
  • Plan, execute, and present at Compassion-related events.
  • In collaboration with regional Volunteer Support Facilitators, enlist and prepare volunteers for Compassion presentations and events.
  • When appropriate, enlist Compassion Ambassadors, Speakers, Alumni, and the like for the purpose of presenting on behalf of Compassion.
  • Manage and submit reports for personal expenses, time sheets, and domestic travel.
  • Regularly meet with Church Engagement Manager for the purpose of reviewing current activity and progress toward team and individual targets.
  • Develop and execute customized multi-year, multi-product strategic engagement plans with key church and event partners, inclusive of the broad range of Compassion’s programmatic and advocacy interventions.
  • Carry out additional responsibilities and projects as assigned.

WHO YOU ARE MATTERS

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • A member in good standing of a local church community with theological positions consistent with those of Compassion Canada.
  • Self-starter attitude and aptitude balanced with an ability to function well as part of a dynamic interdisciplinary team.
  • Ability to develop and maintain effective partnerships, with a track record of growing relationships and revenue.
  • Expertise in fundraising with in-depth knowledge of church trends, event logistics, and portfolio management.
  • Honesty and integrity, with the ability to be discreet and confidential.
  • Excellent communication, planning, organizational, interpersonal, and analytical skills.
  • Eagerness to find new and creative ways to increase Compassion’s influence.
  • Proven skill and proficiency in related fundraising and/or sales environments.
  • Ability to work at an advanced level with a variety of systems, including desktop and cloud-based applications, databases, report writing applications, and Customer Relationship Management software.
  • Willing and able to travel regularly regionally and domestically.
  • Strong administrative skills and not deterred by clerical work.
  • Experience working with multicultural/diaspora communities is a strong asset.

WHAT YOU BRING MATTERS

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Degree or Professional Certification in Fundraising, Church Ministry, Sales, Marketing, or Public Relations is strongly preferred.
  • Must hold a valid driver’s licence in the province or territory of residence.
  • A minimum of (3) three to (5) five years’ experience in church engagement, event partnership management, fundraising, or a related field is required.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining effective partnerships with churches, event partners, or similar stakeholders is required.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple portfolios, including tracking outcomes and achieving revenue or engagement targets.
  • Experience mobilizing volunteers or teams to implement partnership, fundraising, or engagement initiatives is strongly preferred.
  • Competency in using Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software, databases, report writing tools, and cloud-based collaboration platforms is required.
  • Awareness of and experience applying multicultural and diaspora community engagement strategies is a strong asset.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Remote-First Employment: This role does not require regular travel to the London, Ontario, Compassion Canada Head Office and is classified as ‘Remote’ with the staff member operating out of a home-based office.
  • This role may be assigned to support a specific Region or Province/Territory. When assigned, primary residence must be within that designated area as it is an essential requirement of the position.
  • Regular regional travel is required.
  • Hybrid or regional office access may be required occasionally for in-person team collaboration and planning sessions.
  • Digital-First Engagement: Relational, team, and organizational meetings, training, and workshops are primarily conducted online via video conferencing and similar tools.
  • Regular regional and occasional domestic travel, including overnight trips, is required for the purpose of relational development, events, and execution of the deliverables of the role.
  • A valid driver’s licence with access and ability to travel regionally and domestically is required.
  • Overtime may be required during peak periods or for special projects, events, or conferences.
  • This role operates within a dynamic, agile, and distributed workforce environment, requiring flexibility, independent decision-making, and effective time management.

NOTES

The foregoing statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills.

Overview

Amyx is seeking a highly qualified Nuclear and CWMD Intelligence Subject Matter Expert (SME) to support the DHS Countering Weapons of Mass Destruction (CWMD) Advisory & Assistance Services (A&AS) contract. This role provides technical, analytical, and intelligence advisory support focused on nuclear, radiological, chemical, biological, and emerging WMD threats.

The SME will directly support CWMD leadership, analysts, and operational partners by delivering threat assessments, intelligence analysis, risk assessments, and decision support related to adversary pathways, capability gaps, and threat trends. This position is critical to ensuring DHS maintains timely, accurate, and actionable insight into CWMD threats affecting homeland security.

Responsibilities

CWMD Intelligence & Threat Analysis

*Provide expert‑level analysis on nuclear and CWMD threats, including state and non‑state actor capabilities, intent, and emerging trends.*Support development of threat assessments, intelligence products, risk assessments, and analytic briefings for CWMD leadership and interagency partners.*Analyze intelligence reporting related to CBRN/nuclear materials, proliferation pathways, acquisition efforts, and potential attack scenarios.

Information Analysis & Decision Support*Contribute to CWMD Information Analysis Directorate (IAD) activities supporting prevention, detection, and disruption of WMD threats.*Synthesize intelligence from multiple sources to support operational planning, capability gap analysis, and program prioritization.*Provide input to strategic and tactical products supporting federal, SLTT, and interagency stakeholders.

Advisory & Assistance Support*Advise Government leadership on CWMD threat posture, analytic methodologies, and intelligence gaps.*Support development and review of reports, briefings, white papers, and decision memoranda.*Translate complex technical and intelligence information into clear, actionable insights for senior decision‑makers.

Interagency & Stakeholder Engagement*Collaborate with DHS components, interagency partners, and mission stakeholders to ensure analytic consistency and information sharing.*Support briefings, working groups, and coordination meetings related to CWMD threat analysis and intelligence integration.

Process Improvement & Analytic Rigor*Apply structured analytic techniques to improve confidence, transparency, and repeatability of CWMD intelligence products.*Contribute to enhancement of analytic workflows, data integration, and reporting processes within CWMD.*Assist in developing metrics and feedback loops to improve analytic quality and timeliness.

Qualifications

*10+ years of experience in intelligence analysis, threat analysis, or national security support related to nuclear, radiological, or CWMD mission areas.*Demonstrated expertise in CBRN or nuclear threat analysis, counter‑proliferation, or CWMD intelligence.*Experience supporting federal homeland security, intelligence, or national security organizations (DHS, DoD, IC, interagency).*Strong ability to produce high‑quality analytic products (written and oral) for senior Government audiences.*Experience working in classified and unclassified analytic environments.*Bachelor’s degree required (Master’s degree preferred) in intelligence studies, national security, nuclear engineering, physics, international relations, or a related field.

*Prior experience supporting DHS CWMD, CISA, DTRA, IC elements, or similar CWMD‑focused organizations.*Background in nuclear fuel cycle analysis, radiological threat assessment, or WMD counter‑threat frameworks.*Experience engaging with SLTT partners or operational stakeholders on CWMD‑related missions.*Familiarity with intelligence community analytic standards, structured analytic techniques, and intelligence reporting frameworks.*Active Top Secret clearance.*Experience supporting A&AS or advisory services contracts.

raw.description:
Job Summary
The work of a Sr. Coding & Coding Quality Educator relates to practices and principles associated with medical record auditing and utilizes various techniques in examining, evaluating and providing feedback and training to various stakeholders (certified coders, physician's practices, etc.) Key responsibilities include setting up a standard medical record auditing process and assisting in all matters relating to implementation of coding quality and coding training programs for Coders and Physicians, creating an integrated Program plan to carry out goals and managing/monitoring progress of the program execution.

Essential Functions

  • The essential functions listed represent the major duties of this role, additional duties may be assigned.
  • Work closely with and coach certified coders and assist in assessing the strengths and weaknesses, ensuring that quality issues translate into timely training and ongoing coding reinforcement to the coders.
  • Verify, document and communicate quality audit results, develop audit reports and evaluate the effectiveness of corrective action plans and follow up.
  • Identify coding opportunities and make recommendations to improve internal controls and operational effectiveness and efficiency.
  • Assist in preparation & development of provider training tools and lead and conduct educational and training programs for physician training on various aspects of documentation and ICD-10-CM coding.
  • Perform review of specific provider/provider group medical records, develop audit reports and communicate audit results to external physician groups and physician group administration.
  • Coordinate quality audit program reporting and provider coding training with appropriate areas within Medicare Advantage Risk Adjustment and promote teamwork.
  • Responsible for the development and ongoing, end-to-end management of the quality audit program ensuring that QA activities and measurements are objective.
  • Responsible for quality audit program performance and adherence to established ICD-10-CM and CMS-HCC coding guidelines, ensuring compliance with all regulations.
  • Develop and maintain appropriate reporting, identifying metrics that will reflect true audit program performance.
  • Gain management concurrence and support for recommended control improvements.
  • Test and improve training program based upon experience and feedback.
  • Gather information, constantly update knowledge on various changes that are happening in the field of quality audit and modify coding guidelines to incorporate new knowledge. Share changes with coders as well as physician practices partners.
  • Manage multiple complex issues and projects simultaneously.
  • Work collaboratively with other areas of Revenue Program Management to identify, implement and monitor continuous improvement opportunities.
  • May require travel 0-25% of the time to Florida Blue office locations and provider engagements.

Required Experience:
5+ years related work experience. Experience Details: Professional coding including proficiency in ICD-10-CM coding guidelines and risk adjustment HCC coding
Related Bachelor’s degree or additional related equivalent work experience
AAPC Certified Professional Medical Auditor (CPMA) certification
AAPC Certified Professional Coding Instructor (CPC-I) certification 1 Year
Knowledge of CMS-HCC risk adjustment data validation process.

Organization and time management skills

Demonstrate written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
Knowledge of government regulations, requirements, and standards related to the management of health information. Knowledge of Scope and Statistical Sampling Methodologies Detail-oriented, commitment to accuracy, ability to problem solve. Working knowledge of MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)

General Physical Demands:
Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects. Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required only occasionally.

Physical/Environmental Activities

Must be able to travel to multiple locations for work (i.e. travel to attend meetings, events, conferences). Occasionally

What We Offer:
As a Florida Blue employee, you will thrive in our Be Well, Work Well, GuideWell culture where being well as an individual, and working well as a team, are both important in serving our members and communities.

To support your wellbeing, comprehensive benefits are offered. As an employee, you will have access to:

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and global travel health insurance;
  • Income protection benefits: life insurance, short- and long-term disability programs;
  • Leave programs to support personal circumstances;
  • Retirement Savings Plan including employer match;
  • Paid time off, volunteer time off, 10 holidays and 2 well-being days;
  • Additional voluntary benefits available; and
  • A comprehensive wellness program

Employee benefits are designed to align with federal and state employment laws. Benefits may vary based on the state in which work is performed. Benefits for intern, part-time and seasonal employees may differ.

To support your financial wellbeing, we offer competitive pay as well as opportunities for incentive or commission compensation. We also conduct regular annual reviews with pay for performance considerations for base pay increases.

Annualized Salary Range: $77,600 - $126,100

Typical Annualized Hiring Range: $77,600 - $97,000

Final pay will be determined with consideration of market competitiveness, internal equity, and the job-related knowledge, skills, training, and experience you bring.

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer committed to cultivating a work experience where everyone feels like they belong and can perform at their best in pursuit of our mission. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

raw.description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?

🔹 Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
🔹 Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
🔹 Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.
Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

The Impact of a Principal Agentic Architect at Coupa:

The Principal Agentic Architect is the primary visionary for Coupa’s most strategic AI-led engagements. You are responsible for setting the "North Star" for how a customer’s procurement and finance organization will evolve from human-led manual tasks to Agentic-led orchestration.

You are a process architect who thinks in "intents" and "outcomes." You will partner with C-suite stakeholders to identify high-impact workflows where Agentic AI can be deployed, creating the strategic blueprint that the Agentic Architects and Enterprise Solution Managers will then build into reality.

What You'll Do:

    • AI Opportunity Mapping: Lead workshops to deconstruct legacy procurement workflows and identify where Coupa Agents (native or custom) can drive the highest ROI.
    • Agentic Deployment Strategy: Help clients determine the "where" and "how" of agent deployment, deciding which processes should be fully autonomous vs. human-in-the-loop.
    • Target Operating Model Design: Define the future-state metrics (KPIs) that the AI transformation must achieve, ensuring they align with board-level goals.
    • Maturity Audit: Evaluate the customer’s AI Readiness across three lenses: Culture (willingness to trust agents), Data (is the intelligence layer fueled correctly?), and Process (is the workflow "agent-ready"?).
    • Blocker Mitigation: Identify internal policy or workforce hurdles early and partner with leadership to dismantle them.
    • Organizational Change (OCM): Advise on workforce shifts, including the creation of AI Centers of Excellence (COE) and the retraining of staff to manage an "AI Workforce."
    • Policy Transformation: Guide customers on updating internal governance to allow for autonomous agent actions (e.g., automated contract redlining or tail-spend negotiation).
    • Architect Collaboration: Act as the "Tone Setter" for the technical team. You define the Vision; the Agentic Architect defines the Build.
    • Roadmap Integration: Bridge the gap between the customer’s long-term transformation goals and the Coupa Product Roadmap to ensure the client is always ahead of the curve

What You Will Bring to Coupa:

  • Agentic AI Expertise: Deep understanding of the GenAI and Agentic AI landscape (LLMs, RAG, autonomous agents). You must understand what agents can and cannot do today.
  • Procurement/Finance Domain: Professional fluency in Source-to-Pay (S2P) processes. You need to understand the "Legacy" pain points to architect the "Agentic" solution.
  • Executive Presence: Possess the dual-fluency to secure C-Suite buy-in on AI vision while simultaneously collaborating with functional leads to map that vision to day-to-day S2P workflows.
  • Proven Digital Transformation Leadership: 10+ years of experience leading large-scale, cross-functional digital transformation initiatives at the Enterprise level.
  • Coupa Experience: Previous experience with the Coupa platform is a plus, but we value Agent-First Thinking above platform familiarity.
  • Consulting Pedigree: Experience in Tier-1 management consulting or leading massive digital transformation projects.
Coupa complies with relevant laws and regulations regarding equal opportunity and offers a welcoming and inclusive work environment. Decisions related to hiring, compensation, training, or evaluating performance are made fairly, and we provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates and employees.
Please be advised that inquiries or resumes from recruiters will not be accepted.
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read Coupa’s Privacy Policy and understand that Coupa receives/collects your application, including your personal data, for the purposes of managing Coupa's ongoing recruitment and placement activities, including for employment purposes in the event of a successful application and for notification of future job opportunities if you did not succeed the first time. raw.title: Site Reliability Specialist III - MS SQL / Medical Imaging Systems
raw.excerpt: The Site Reliability Specialist III plays a critical role in maintaining the performance, availability, and scalability of Intelerad's mission-critical healthcare imaging platforms.
raw.description:
The Site Reliability Specialist III plays a critical role in maintaining the performance, availability, and scalability of Intelerad's mission-critical healthcare imaging platforms. This position combines deep technical expertise in SQL database administration, system administration, software deployments, and cloud infrastructure to ensure our PACS, RIS, and enterprise imaging solutions deliver the reliability that healthcare providers depend on 24/7. In addition to core database responsibilities, the role includes hands-on system administration tasks and software deployment activities typically performed by a system administrator. As healthcare IT continues its evolution toward cloud-based architectures, this role will be instrumental in supporting and advancing our cloud transformation initiatives while maintaining the high standards of system performance our clients expect.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure system reliability and performance across production environments by proactively monitoring infrastructure health (servers, OS, databases, and applications), identifying performance bottlenecks, and implementing solutions that maintain 99.9%+ uptime for mission-critical healthcare imaging systems
  • Optimize SQL database performance and maintenance by analyzing query execution plans, implementing indexing strategies, performing database tuning, and executing maintenance routines that ensure fast, reliable access to imaging data across multiple SQL Server-based applications
  • Perform software deployments, including planning, testing, and executing application and system updates, patches, and new releases across on-premises and cloud environments, while minimizing downtime and ensuring compatibility with existing healthcare imaging workflows
  • Execute core system administration tasks such as server provisioning, OS patching and hardening (Windows/Linux), user account and access management, security configuration, file system maintenance, and backup/recovery operations beyond just databases
  • Support cloud infrastructure operations by managing and maintaining cloud-based deployments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), implementing infrastructure-as-code practices, and contributing to the migration of on-premises systems to cloud environments
  • Lead incident response and troubleshooting by diagnosing complex system, database, and deployment issues, coordinating resolution efforts across teams, conducting root cause analysis, and implementing preventive measures to reduce future incidents
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives by identifying automation opportunities (including deployment pipelines and routine sysadmin tasks), documenting system configurations and procedures, implementing monitoring and alerting enhancements, and collaborating with development teams to improve application reliability, performance, and deploy-ability
  • Work on weekends, after hours and holidays as needed to support our clients; participate in an on-call rotation to aid in troubleshooting or execute emergency changes

Travel Requirements: Occasional travel may be required for client escalations or team collaboration (up to 10%)

This job description is not a comprehensive list of tasks or requirements and Intelerad reserves the right to change it at any time.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in system administration, site reliability engineering, database administration, or similar technical operations roles supporting enterprise production environments
  • Strong SQL Server experience including performance tuning, query optimization, index management, backup/recovery procedures, and database maintenance in production environments
  • Demonstrated system administration experience, including Windows and/or Linux server management, OS installation/configuration/upgrades, patching, security hardening, user and permission management, and hardware/software troubleshooting
  • Hands-on experience with software deployments, release management, and application rollout processes in production environments (including change control, rollback planning, and post-deployment validation)
  • Proficiency with Windows and/or Linux server administration, including scripting and automation (PowerShell, Bash, Python) for both database and general system tasks
  • Demonstrated experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) including compute services, storage solutions, networking, and cloud-native monitoring tools
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, DataDog, or similar)
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with ability to diagnose complex technical issues under pressure
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

  • Cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator, Google Cloud Professional, or equivalent)
  • Experience with healthcare IT systems, particularly PACS, RIS, or medical imaging platforms
  • Knowledge of healthcare data standards and compliance requirements (HIPAA, DICOM, HL7)
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM templates)
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience with SQL Server high availability solutions (Always On, clustering, replication)
  • Understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines (especially as they relate to software deployments and system updates)
  • Experience with virtualization technologies (VMware, Hyper-V) and server hardware management

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Applicants may be required to complete an online technical and/or personality assessment as part of your application.

Vālenz® Health is the platform to simplify healthcare – the destination for employers, payers, providers and members to reduce costs, improve quality, and elevate the healthcare experience. The Valenz mindset and culture of innovation combine to create a distinctly different approach to an inefficient, uninspired health system. With fully integrated solutions, Valenz engages early and often to execute across the entire patient journey – from care navigation and management to payment integrity, plan performance and provider verification. With a 99% client retention rate, we elevate expectations to a new level of efficiency, effectiveness and transparency where smarter, better, faster healthcare is possible.

About This Opportunity:
As the Manager of Operational Excellence, you’ll help drive process improvement efforts across the organization and turn strategy into action. You’ll leverage Lean and Six Sigma methodologies to ensure consistent execution of key initiatives, from optimizing internal workflows to supporting client implementation readiness.

Things You’ll Do Here:
  • Lead enterprise-wide continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean Six Sigma and DMAIC methodologies to drive measurable efficiencies, enhance quality, reduce waste, and optimize operational performance.
  • Design and implement scalable process improvements that strengthen accuracy, throughput, and compliance in payment integrity operations, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements, client expectations, and organizational performance goals.
  • Leverage technology, data analytics, and automation tools to streamline workflows, reduce manual touchpoints, improve cycle times, and enhance reporting transparency. Partner with technical teams to evaluate and implement process automation solutions that support sustainable operational gains.
  • Facilitate cross-functional workshops and working sessions, including value stream mapping, process mapping, and root cause analysis (RCA), to uncover operational gaps, identify bottlenecks, and prioritize high-impact improvement opportunities.
  • Collaborate closely with Implementation, Client Success, Product, and Core Operations teams to design, document, and operationalize end-to-end workflows supporting new client onboarding, product enhancements, and service expansions within the Payment Integrity portfolio.
  • Establish standardized operating procedures (SOPs) and governance frameworks to ensure process consistency, scalability, and repeatability across pre-payment and post-payment integrity functions.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks that may affect service delivery, financial outcomes, regulatory compliance, or client experience, implementing controls and monitoring mechanisms to ensure ongoing stability and performance.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive project documentation, including charters, business cases, stakeholder analyses, process documentation, KPIs, dashboards, and post-implementation reviews to ensure transparency and accountability.
  • Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure operational effectiveness, quantify improvement impact, and support data-driven decision-making across the Payment Integrity vertical.
  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement, providing coaching and guidance to operational leaders and frontline teams to build internal capability in problem-solving, process discipline, and performance optimization.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential duties.


What You’ll Bring to the Team:
  • 5+ years in an operational excellence or continuous improvement role leading and executing DMAIC projects.
  • 3+ years of experience in healthcare administration, health insurance, or equivalent, leveraging healthcare technology to automate processes.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with strong presentation abilities in-person and virtually.

A plus if you have:
  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, healthcare administration, or related field.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt certification.
  • Experience supporting large-scale process transitions.
  • Experience supporting client implementations.

Where You’ll Work: This is a fully remote position, and we’ll provide all the necessary equipment!
  • Work Environment: You’ll need a quiet workspace that is free from distractions.
  • Technology: Reliable internet connection—if you can use streaming services, you’re good to go!
  • Security: Adherence to company security protocols, including the use of VPNs, secure passwords, and company-approved devices/software.
  • Location: You must be US based, in a location where you can work effectively and comply with company policies such as HIPAA.

Why You'll Love Working Here

Valenz is proud to be recognized by Inc. 5000 as one of America’s fastest-growing private companies. Our team is committed to delivering on our promise to engage early and often for smarter, better, faster healthcare.With this commitment, you’ll find an engaged culture – one that stands strong, vigorous, and healthy in all we do.

Benefits

  • Generously subsidized company-sponsored Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance, with access to services through our own products, Healthcare Blue Book and KISx Card.
  • Spending account options: HSA, FSA, and DCFSA
  • 401K with company match and immediate vesting

  • Generous Paid Time Off to include vacation, sick leave, and paid holidays

BILINGUAL INTERPRETER L4 – 100% REMOTE (MEXICO)

Not all heroes wear capes. Some wear headsets.

Welcome to our League of Interpreter Heroes. Here, your voice is your superpower and every call is a mission. We are seeking Spanish–English Bilingual Interpreters to work 100% remotely from Mexico, collaborating with Kelly through its specialized service for a global leader in language solutions.

If you have ever dreamed of connecting people, saving conversations, and breaking communication barriers, this is your opportunity.

POSITION DESCRIPTION

As an L4 Interpreter, you will serve as the communication bridge in three-way calls between the client, the Limited English Proficient (LEP) individual, and yourself as the interpreter.

Your daily missions may include:

  • Assisting in medical emergencies.

  • Facilitating communication in sensitive legal situations.

  • Supporting emergency calls.
